subject: general
question: Anand can construct a wall in 4 days, while Rajan can complete the same work in 7 days. In how many days will Anand and Rajan construct the wall if they work together?
solution:
Given:

Anand can construct a wall in 4 days, while Rajan can complete the same work in 7 days.

Calculation: 

According to the question:

Work done by Anand in 1 day = 1/4 work

Work done by Rajan alone in 1 day = 1/7

Work done by both alone in 1 day = (1/4) + (1/7)

⇒ (7 + 4)/28 parts of work 

⇒ 11/28 part of the work 

The total time taken by both = 28/11

∴ The total time taken by ** Anand and Rajan** to to complete the work is 2(6/11) days.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95910374d7f99d1809bc074225e91c45cab078f42585a125dcef6af5b9f5fd92.png] 

Work = Efficiency × Time

Anand = 4 days 

Rajan = 7 days

Let the total work be 28 [LCM (4 , 7)]

Anand's efficiency = 28/4 = 7

Rajan's efficiency = 28/7 = 4

Total efficiency = 11

Time taken by both to complete the work = 28/11

∴ The total time taken by B to complete the work is 2(6/11) days.
